# Example outputs (generated by `razorpdf parse`, v0.1.x)

- `gst_tax_invoice.md` / `.json` — 9-column bordered table + parties/GSTIN
  header, fully geometric (0 VLM regions).
- `financial_borderless.md` / `.json` — rulings-free 3-row table with a
  rotated watermark correctly isolated in its own chunk.
- `attention_table1.md` / `.json` — Table 1 from "Attention Is All You
  Need" (`arxiv_attention_2col.pdf` p.6) as Markdown + one grounded chunk.

Regenerate from the repo root (wild corpus required, see
`tests/wild/README.md`):

```bash
./target/release/razorpdf parse tests/wild/gst_tax_invoice.pdf \
  -o examples/gst_tax_invoice.md --json examples/gst_tax_invoice.json
```
